items.t: Palantir Stocks Climb 3.72% on $300 Million Poland Defense AI Deal
items.sum: Poland's defense minister confirmed a five-year software contract covering the country's defense and security infrastructure.

items.t: PLTR Stock Sees Best Week In 4 Months: Palantir Bags Reported $300M Defense Deal With Poland
items.sum: The five-year agreement will give Poland’s armed forces access to Palantir’s Maven Smart System, which is already used by NATO and the U.S. military.

items.t: Peter Thiel Takes $122M of Palantir Off the Market
items.sum: The last time Thiel traded PLTR, he was selling.

items.t: Palantir Lands Major Defense Deal as European Demand Grows
items.sum: The software giant's next growth opportunity lies beyond America.

items.t: Palantir Raised Its 2026 Growth Outlook to 91%. Could the Stock Have More Room to Run?
items.sum: Palantir just posted the fastest growth of its public life, yet the stock sank more than 20% in a month. A hidden weak spot in its bookings may explain why Wall Street is split on what comes next.

items.t: PLTR vs. ARM: Which AI-Tech Stock is Better Positioned Now?
items.sum: Palantir and Arm Holdings stand to benefit from accelerating AI adoption, but stronger revenue growth, profitability and liquidity give one stock an edge over the other.
